rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to place an event within a named time period.

example.english: I went traveling during summer vacation.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 syu2 gaa3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this when the action or state lasts through the whole time period.

example.english: I didn’t go out at all during the whole week.
example.traditional: 我成個星期都冇出過街。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 mou5 ceot1 gwo3 gaai1
